text:
liz: FYI I opened a small docs PR to tidy the troubleshooting runbook for 429s/timeouts. Main goals: fix a few dead links, add a tiny reproducible curl example that surfaces Retry-After, and include a short local/staging repro note. Can someone eyeball?

owen: Thanks — on it. Please make the curl clearly non-prod (synthetic token) and include the exact header names we recommend we surface in SDKs (`Retry-After`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`).

liz: Yep, used a synthetic token and a staging endpoint in the examples. Curl snippet in PR: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://staging-api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SYNTHETIC_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"mini-test","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":1}'
```
This shows a 429 response and headers we can parse for backoff.

tara: Can you add a 2-line Python retry example (requests + backoff) for the runbook? We'll link to that from SDK quickstart. Keep it tiny.

liz: Added a micro snippet: `for i in range(5): sleep(backoff_with_jitter(i)); resp = requests.post(...); if resp.status_code!=429: break` and a short note to use exponential backoff with capped jitter.

ci-bot: Linkcheck running on branch docs/429-cleanup. Found 2 broken routes:
- /guides/old-fallback -> 404
- /sdk/js/retry-v1 -> 410

sam: Good catch. Those are from legacy anchors in the runbook. Recommend we redirect `/guides/old-fallback` -> `/runbooks/fallbacks` and update the JS SDK link to `/sdk/js/retries` (new location).

liz: Pushed redirects and updated anchors. Also added an explicit note explaining `Retry-After` units (seconds from server) and how to handle sub-second precision when servers include float values.

natalie: Quick editorial: clarify that `X-RateLimit-Reset` is an epoch timestamp in seconds, and recommend computing delta = reset - now. Small wording tweak suggested in the PR.

liz: Applied Natalie's edit. Also added a short bullet about context-window guidance: show a real-world example of trimming user history before sending to the model and link to `ctx-trimmer` CLI (internal tool).

owen: LGTM after one nit: change the staging endpoint domain to `staging.redwood-inference.net` to match infra naming.

liz: Updated endpoint host and pushed.

deploy-bot: Staging docs deploy scheduled for 2026-04-02 03:30 UTC. Manual QA flagged: check snippets render correctly in the runbook preview.

liz: I'll preview and confirm rendering. Thanks everyone! Closing once staging passes. :shipit:
